name: Cathedral Voronoi
promptTemplate: A stained-glass window of {{glass_style}} glass with {{lead_width}}px lead came, drifting at {{drift_speed}} speed under {{light_source}} with relaxation {{relaxation}}.

ui.title: Cathedral Glass
ui.tagline: Stained-glass Voronoi drifting under cathedral light

glass_style.hint: Recolour panes to Chartres blues, ambers, or rose wheel

lead_width.hint: Thicken or narrow the dark lead came borders

drift_speed.hint: Rate at which seed points glide across the pane

relaxation.hint: Pull erratic shards towards balanced honeycomb cells

light_source.hint: Shift illumination angle and caustic glint

listing.blurb: A stained-glass window from a Voronoi diagram: drifting seed points, one per person in their colour, cells filled with glowing glass and thick lead lines, relaxing gently towards even cells.
listing.prompt: A stained-glass window from a Voronoi diagram: drifting seed points, one per person in their colour, cells filled with glowing glass and thick lead lines, relaxing gently towards even cells. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
